html: נִמְרִים n.pr.loc. in Moab (cf. Sab. נמרן attrib. of Barḳm., DHMZMG xxix (1875), 592, v. also CISiv. No. 103, p. 169; مَآءٌ نَمِيرٌ wholesome water Lane2853, also Wel.c.);—only מֵי נִמְרִים Is 15:6 Je 48:34; prob. = Βηνναμαρειμ LagOnom. 284, 33, in Wady Numêre at SE. end of Dead Sea, BuhlGeogr. 272.
